verdict.rationale: A keyless probe of the GOV.UK Content API, the publishing layer that serves Companies House guidance, returned HTTP 200 with a JSON body and no bot wall. The API's 401 is a structured auth challenge on the data API, not a wall in front of guidance. However, the probed page is a general GOV.UK business guide, not a Companies House-specific page, and no HTML fetch with an identified user agent was recorded. Missing for 10: a direct keyless probe of Companies House guidance and developer-docs HTML pages, explicit confirmation of no CAPTCHA or JS-only shell under a standard identified user agent, and an agent-oriented docs index (llms.txt returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service's published guidance pages are reachable by a keyless agent with a standard identified user agent — no bot wall, JS-only shell, or CAPTCHA in front of the public reading surface

citations.quote: a real public REST API that answers unauthenticated requests with a structured auth challenge: free registered API keys, an auth model, not a bot wall
